Subject: Request to Cancel Thursday’s Call

Hi [Client Name],

I hope you’re well. I’m sorry for the short notice, but I need to cancel our call scheduled for Thursday. I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Would you be available to reschedule? I’m free on [Option 1: day/time] or [Option 2: day/time], or please let me know a time that works for you.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

Note: I won’t modify your calendar or cancel the event — this is just a draft you can send.
